seed_role: Development-window localization only. The automatic function receives seed but no human correspondences or upper target labels. Not a blind detector.
local_domain: For each baseline group containing a nominated seed, pair with EVERY other baseline group having any threshold-compatible cross-person pair; retain all nodes in the two groups. Others frozen. Enumerate all unordered nonempty two-block partitions of this union under diameter and one-worker constraints. Do not combine overlapping-window alternatives.
outside_domain: All memberships outside the two groups frozen, no local node allowed to escape elsewhere or disappear. All original source rings unchanged. Roster denominator unchanged.
cost: W=sum_g [sum_{i<j in g}(d_ij/tau)^2 / |g|]. Dispersion objective, NOT semantic truth or calibrated likelihood.
edit_cost: Minimum number of nodes changing block, after optimal two-label alignment with baseline. Equal alignments retained.

policies.automatic_minimal: If any feasible alternative strictly improves W by >1e-10, minimize edit count then W; keep every numerical tie (1e-10), plus preserve baseline and complete Pareto/frontier ledger. Otherwise unchanged. Cross-window alternatives are separate, not silently combined.
policies.human_assisted: In the identical local domains, add given same-corner must-links and rejected rpc cannot-links, then minimize edit count followed by W. Infeasible or domain-incomplete constraints remain failures; no threshold relaxation. Not automatic success.

center: Periodic medoid-anchored coordinate median, copied interpretation from existing baseline; all tied center anchors examined; no output source mutation.
unb: Freeze bottom grouping per threshold; retain original paired upper endpoints. Upper geometrical partitions within a bottom group are exploratory; preserve every subthreshold upper group, named semantics only for explicitly reviewed observations. No unknown-to-known semantic propagation and no full ring creation.
gt_policy: No GT files are loaded anywhere in this round. Development cases historically exposed; not a blind experiment.
not_solved: semantic meaning of unknown upper endpoints
